title: OR-normalization preserves literal count
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $c$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables. The literal count of the OR-normal form obtained from $c$ equals the literal count of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables
replaced:
For every Boolean circuit $c$ on $n$ variables, converting $c$ to OR-normal form leaves
its total number of literal occurrences unchanged: the literal count of the normal-form
OR circuit obtained from $c$ equals the literal count of $c$ itself.
